input.command:
CFG=/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/database/my.cnf.prod
OUT=/Users/mac/Desktop/CHcode/.claude/database/reports/attribution
START=2026-09-01
END=2026-09-04
END_EXCL=2026-09-05

SQL_FILE="$OUT/_weekly_product_queries__${START}_to_${END}.sql"
RAW="$OUT/_weekly_raw__${START}_to_${END}.txt"

cat > "$SQL_FILE" <<EOF
-- 本周归因产品报告取数（prod 只读）
-- 窗口：${START}（周一）～ ${END}（周五；今日 2026-09-05 周六）
-- 完整自然周到 09-06；周六及以后分区视日批

-- 1) 配置已开
SELECT app_id, config_name, is_rewrite_channel, is_active, min_threshold,
       DATE(update_time) AS upd, DATE(create_time) AS crt
FROM dim.dim_app_attribution_config
WHERE is_run = 1 AND app_id <> 'default'
ORDER BY app_id;

-- 2) 本周配置变动
SELECT app_id, config_name, is_run, is_rewrite_channel, update_time
FROM dim.dim_app_attribution_config
WHERE app_id <> 'default'
  AND update_time >= '${START}'
  AND update_time < '${END_EXCL}'
ORDER BY update_time;

-- 3) 注册侧：iOS 自然量 / 打标
SELECT
  r.app_id,
  COUNT(*) AS ios_organic_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(r.attribution_flag AS INT) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flag1_cnt
FROM dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2 r
INNER JOIN dim.dim_app_attribution_config c
  ON r.app_id = c.app_id AND c.is_run = 1
WHERE r.dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) IN ('ios', 'iphone', 'ipad')
  AND (
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, ''))) IN ('', 'organic', '自然量')
    OR r.channel IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY r.app_id
ORDER BY flag1_cnt DESC, ios_organic_cnt DESC;

-- 4) 结果侧：有候选 / 成功 / 未归因
SELECT
  app_id,
  COUNT(*) AS candidate_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN attribution_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN attribution_status = 'unattributed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unattr_cnt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
WHERE dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
GROUP BY app_id
ORDER BY candidate_cnt DESC;

-- 5) 有产出 app 分日（结果行 / 成功）
SELECT
  dt, app_id,
  COUNT(*) AS result_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN attribution_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
WHERE dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
GROUP BY dt, app_id
ORDER BY app_id, dt;

-- 6) 日指标表是否断流
SELECT MAX(dt) AS metrics_max_dt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_metrics_d_d;

-- 7) 未归因原因分布（有结果产品）
SELECT
  app_id,
  unattributed_reason,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
WHERE dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
  AND attribution_status = 'unattributed'
GROUP BY app_id, unattributed_reason
ORDER BY app_id, cnt DESC;
EOF

{
  echo "===== 1 CONFIG is_run=1 ====="
  mysql --defaults-extra-file="$CFG" -B -e "
SELECT app_id, config_name, is_rewrite_channel, is_active, min_threshold,
       DATE(update_time) AS upd, DATE(create_time) AS crt
FROM dim.dim_app_attribution_config
WHERE is_run = 1 AND app_id <> 'default'
ORDER BY app_id;"

  echo "===== 2 CONFIG CHANGES ====="
  mysql --defaults-extra-file="$CFG" -B -e "
SELECT app_id, config_name, is_run, is_rewrite_channel, update_time
FROM dim.dim_app_attribution_config
WHERE app_id <> 'default'
  AND update_time >= '${START}'
  AND update_time < '${END_EXCL}'
ORDER BY update_time;"

  echo "===== 3 REG ios organic / flag ====="
  mysql --defaults-extra-file="$CFG" -B -e "
SELECT
  r.app_id,
  COUNT(*) AS ios_organic_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(r.attribution_flag AS INT) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flag1_cnt
FROM dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2 r
INNER JOIN dim.dim_app_attribution_config c
  ON r.app_id = c.app_id AND c.is_run = 1
WHERE r.dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) IN ('ios', 'iphone', 'ipad')
  AND (
    LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(r.channel, ''))) IN ('', 'organic', '自然量')
    OR r.channel IS NULL
  )
GROUP BY r.app_id
ORDER BY flag1_cnt DESC, ios_organic_cnt DESC;"

  echo "===== 4 RESULT candidates ====="
  mysql --defaults-extra-file="$CFG" -B -e "
SELECT
  app_id,
  COUNT(*) AS candidate_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN attribution_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN attribution_status = 'unattributed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unattr_cnt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
WHERE dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
GROUP BY app_id
ORDER BY candidate_cnt DESC;"

  echo "===== 5 RESULT by day ====="
  mysql --defaults-extra-file="$CFG" -B -e "
SELECT
  dt, app_id,
  COUNT(*) AS result_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN attribution_status = 'success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
WHERE dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
GROUP BY dt, app_id
ORDER BY app_id, dt;"

  echo "===== 6 METRICS max dt ====="
  mysql --defaults-extra-file="$CFG" -B -e "
SELECT MAX(dt) AS metrics_max_dt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_metrics_d_d;"

  echo "===== 7 UNATTR reasons ====="
  mysql --defaults-extra-file="$CFG" -B -e "
SELECT
  app_id,
  unattributed_reason,
  COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
WHERE dt BETWEEN '${START}' AND '${END}'
  AND attribution_status = 'unattributed'
GROUP BY app_id, unattributed_reason
ORDER BY app_id, cnt DESC;"
} > "$RAW" 2>&1

echo "DONE raw=$(wc -l < "$RAW") sql=$SQL_FILE"
head -5 "$RAW"
tail -20 "$RAW"
